The Taj Mahal Palace, Mumbai — a festive-gifting suite (2018).

Four routes for the property's luxury hampers, each its own world: a cobalt-leather box, a paisley round box, a laser-etched silver jali box, and a green-velvet box with a gold tassel — plus Mughal-jali and baroque wrapping papers and a set of outer-box charms. One holistic unboxing, designed four ways.

Festive gifting design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·57.
